subsystem.name: High-Fantasy Typography & Responsive Font Subsystem
axioms: TrueType font files strictly located in assets/fonts/ with fonts.dir/fonts.scale descriptors
Zero-heap glyph metrics caching: pre-rendered character advance tables
Strict aspect ratio preservation: fonts scale proportionally with letterbox/pillarbox
Graceful fallback: plain ASCII 8x16 bitmap font in headless or unrasterized environments
